title: The ILO signs first public-private partnership agreements to advance inclusive wage-setting processes
discussion_signal: The post presents public-private partnerships with business groups and companies as a way to move living-wage commitments from tripartite policy agreement toward implementation while connecting worker living standards with enterprise and economy sustainability.
linked_research_question: When living wages move from voluntary commitment to shared wage-setting infrastructure, how are worker needs, public standards, and enterprise sustainability reconciled?
limits: The announcement concerns agreements and intended implementation, not measured wage outcomes
The post is institutionally positive and does not present worker opposition or enforcement failures
It does not establish whether purchasing power improves across countries
